'''Bent Spur''' was an individual who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[D'Mayna Stallaphalat]] sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to find Spur, who owed her money.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempSwooperGangmember.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Bent Spur]]
Bent Spur was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
